programme.title: E1 - Squirrel Trouble & Other Wacky Problems!
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble & other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. But the wacky problems don't stop there! When a ghost crashes playtime, Arpo has to use all his tech to bust it. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably & when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: E1 - Creative Farm Adventures!
programme.desc: Get ready for some creative farm adventures with Ella! First, Ella brings school to Lellobee City Farm by creating a classroom in the Boogie Barn & teaching all her animal friends. Then, she helps Mei make some delicious jam using fresh strawberries, grapes & blueberries from the farm! The creative day ends with a magical night of stargazing, where Mei points out constellations that look just like the animals on the farm.

programme.title: E4 - JJ's August Art Explorers
programme.desc: It's an Artsy August crafting adventure! Help JJ, Kiki, and Emmy make a hot air balloon to chase Boba's lost balloon. Then, unlock a pirate treasure chest, have a dance party on a disco mat, and bake some delicious alphabet cupcakes!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures S1E1 -High-Flying Fun!
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, & learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok & the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, & discovery.

programme.title: E1 - Mom's Crazy Inventions Go Haywire!
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo & Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum & they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride & Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: E1 - Stan's Artsy August
programme.desc: Join an Artsy August dress-up party! Pretend to be anything you can imagine. Dive under the sea to count colorful fish, make yummy pancakes in different shapes, and cheer on Mia as she learns to ride her two-wheel bike!

programme.title: E2 - A Big Day of Games & Fun!
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of discovery & play with Twinkle & her friends! The fun starts as they learn to play new musical instruments, with Twinkle on drums, Kitty on the sax & Bunny on guitar! Then, it's time to play a fun game of 'Twinkle Says'! Follow along as they give you playful instructions & see if you can keep up. The discoveries continue as the friends find a mirror & make funny faces & wonder what an umbrella is for before it starts to rain!

programme.title: E1 - The Ultimate Teamwork & Rescue Special!
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate teamwork & rescue special with Kii & Yii! The adventure begins when Princess Cat is flying her plane but gets in a sticky jammy mess, causing her to lose control! It's up to Kii & Yii to get her down safely. Then, the friends are playing near Princess Cat's castle when she accidentally falls down the well & needs to be rescued again! From helping Humpty Dumpty to rounding up runaway vegetables, Kii & Yii always save the day!

programme.title: E8 - Baby John's August Art Box
programme.desc: Get crafty for Artsy August! Dig into Baby John's craft box and make a whole family of finger puppets. Then, play a fun color-matching game with a new train, count magical potatoes, and have a bubbly, colorful bath time adventure!

programme.desc: It's a day of yummy food & clean-up fun with JJ! First, learn about all types of pasta & make some from scratch in Grandma's kitchen. JJ's family gives Bingo a scrub in the tub after he gets dirty playing outside, & all the kids chip in to wash a filthy firetruck. It's fun to make a mess, & even more fun to clean up!

E45 - The Direction Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels go out for a walk but can't find a way back to the clubhouse.

programme.title: E31 - Bus-Train
programme.desc: Cynthia is working on the bus so asks Stanley to take her passengers to the community centre. He uses Amare's tractor and trailer, his car, a boat, and a bath to make a Bus-Train.

programme.title: E30 - Leaves
programme.desc: There are leaves all over the place, Stanley tries to gather them up in his van with his leaf blower, but it is harder than he thought and fills Myrtle's house with them instead.

programme.title: E15 - I Can Make A Dolphin Noise
programme.desc: Back stroke and doggy paddle, flips, and roly-polys. The animals talk about all the fun stuff when swimming.

programme.title: E24 - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: E25 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: E26 - Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: E22 - The Feelings Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels notice that Happy isn't acting like his normal self, and he's strangely wearing new trainers. Happy doesn't know what he's feeling, and his friends want to help him.

E13
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: E11
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 根據小說《Sales夫婦》改編。一場盛宴之下的狂歡，讓隱藏已久的暗湧現，喚醒了所有裝睡的人，也觸發了GST酒業各層人士的生存危機。一切事關生存，每一步都需格外謹慎。七個深陷其中的主要人物，在事件中扮演了不同的角色，勾勒出人性的複雜和現實的殘酷，從而呈現出一個共同的主題——如何在惶惶不安中樂觀地活下去！

programme.title: E95
programme.desc: The 114th drama serial follows two women, Rin (Mikami Ai) and Naomi (Kosaka Juri), who paved the way for nursing in the Meiji era. Each carries her own struggles, yet together they support one another as they race to protect the wounded and vulnerable, often standing up against powerful forces. Through conflicts and hardships, the two gradually grow. No matter which way the wind blows, this unconventional duo continues their journey in search of happiness.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: Detective Kitamine (Ono Machiko) visits former police officer Saji (Kobayashi Kaoru) to question him about a murder case. The victim is a man Saji once arrested for stalking a woman. As the investigation progresses, Kitamine grows more suspicious of Saji being the criminal. Out of pride as a former police officer, Saji strives to prove his innocence, but he begins to doubt himself. In fact, he has dementia.

programme.title: Reign of Assassins
programme.desc: In 428AD, Bodhi, Prince of Southern India, becomes a Buddhist monk and sets off for China, earning a hallowed reputation as a mystical martial artist. Following his death, his remains mysteriously disappear. It is rumored that his remains contain the secret to obtaining limitless power and ruling the martial arts world. Centuries later, The Dark Stone emerges as a team of deadly assassins; their best assassin is the ruthless, invincible Drizzle. On her latest mission, Drizzle takes out Zhang Haiduan, a high-ranking court official. Zhang's son, Renfeng, while mourning his father's death, is also attacked and seemingly killed by Drizzle and her fellow assassins. Drizzle's life changes when she kills Lu Zhu, a monk with whom she has unintentionally fallen in love...

programme.title: Needing You

programme.title: The Moment
programme.desc: 'The Moment' talks about four relationships - A couple breaking up yet holding tight; a father and a daughter meeting up after a long separation; a girl escaping from growing up; and two buddies' reunion after years of misunderstanding. Different people carry different stories. The stories are connected by a vintage photography studio holder. Their experiences bring out a variety of sensations to the city we are living in; these feelings belong to them, and also us.

Fatal Engineering revisits major nuclear disasters, from the 1986 Chernobyl meltdown to Fukushima’s tsunami-induced failure. These sobering events forced the world to rethink nuclear safety forever.
